import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

def mat(name, col):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*col, 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
    m.diffuse_color = (*col, 1)
    return m

wood = mat("Wood", (0.42, 0.24, 0.11))
wood_dark = mat("Wood Dark", (0.28, 0.15, 0.07))

def build(name, boxes, loc, rot_z=0):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for (cx, cy, cz), (sx, sy, sz), mi in boxes:
        r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        verts = r["verts"]
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(sx, sy, sz), verts=verts)
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(cx, cy, cz), verts=verts)
        for f in {f for v in verts for f in v.link_faces}:
            f.material_index = mi
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    me.materials.append(wood); me.materials.append(wood_dark)
    old = bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if old: bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler.z = rot_z
    return ob

# Table: 1.6 x 1.0 top at 0.75 high
tw, td, th, tt = 1.6, 1.0, 0.75, 0.05
leg = 0.07
boxes = [((0, 0, th - tt/2), (tw, td, tt), 0)]
for sx in (-1, 1):
    for sy in (-1, 1):
        boxes.append(((sx*(tw/2-0.1), sy*(td/2-0.1), (th-tt)/2), (leg, leg, th-tt), 1))
# aprons
boxes.append(((0, td/2-0.1, th-tt-0.05), (tw-0.2, 0.03, 0.1), 1))
boxes.append(((0, -(td/2-0.1), th-tt-0.05), (tw-0.2, 0.03, 0.1), 1))
boxes.append(((tw/2-0.1, 0, th-tt-0.05), (0.03, td-0.2, 0.1), 1))
boxes.append(((-(tw/2-0.1), 0, th-tt-0.05), (0.03, td-0.2, 0.1), 1))
build("Table", boxes, (0, 0, 0))

# Chair local: faces +Y (toward table), back at -Y
cw, sh, st, cl = 0.45, 0.45, 0.04, 0.045
chair = [((0, 0, sh - st/2), (cw, cw, st), 0)]
for sx in (-1, 1):
    for sy in (-1, 1):
        h = sh - st if sy > 0 else 0.95
        chair.append(((sx*(cw/2-cl/2), sy*(cw/2-cl/2), h/2), (cl, cl, h), 1))
# backrest slats
chair.append(((0, -(cw/2-cl/2), 0.88), (cw-cl, 0.03, 0.1), 0))
chair.append(((0, -(cw/2-cl/2), 0.68), (cw-cl, 0.03, 0.08), 0))
# stretchers
chair.append(((0, cw/2-cl/2, 0.15), (cw-cl, 0.025, 0.03), 1))
chair.append(((0, -(cw/2-cl/2), 0.15), (cw-cl, 0.025, 0.03), 1))

# positions: two at long sides, one at each end
placements = [
    ((0, -0.85, 0), 0),            # faces +Y
    ((1.15, 0, 0), math.pi/2),     # faces -X
    ((0, 0.85, 0), math.pi),       # faces -Y
    ((-1.15, 0, 0), -math.pi/2),   # faces +X
]
for i, (loc, rz) in enumerate(placements, 1):
    build(f"Chair {i}", chair, loc, rz)
print([o.name for o in bpy.data.objects])
